skills.name: context-checkpoint
skills.description: Compress a long task into a small, evidence-linked checkpoint before the local context window or handoff budget is exhausted.
skills.capability_note: Guidance only; does not alter context limits or grant tools.

skills.name: decision-routing
skills.description: Choose a bounded local worker or tool from an explicit eligible set while preserving scope, resource, and permission constraints.
skills.capability_note: Guidance only; routing cannot create permission or availability.

skills.name: harness-evaluation
skills.description: Evaluate a local agent route, model adapter, tool boundary, or recovery change with fixed tasks and observable acceptance evidence.
skills.capability_note: Guidance only; evaluation results depend on executed evidence.

skills.name: memq-operations
skills.description: Use an optional configured memory provider for bounded recall and evidence-linked checkpoints after verifying its live identity and project scope.
skills.capability_note: Guidance only; a live verified provider is required for memory access.

skills.name: ot-ics-defense
skills.description: Monitor, evaluate, respond to, and prevent cyber attacks on Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), PLCs, RTUs, and SCADA/HMI infrastructure.
skills.capability_note: Guidance only; combines with native audit_ot_exposure tool for deterministic config audits.

skills.name: nexus-topology-recon
skills.description: Map codebase routes, functions, dependencies, and syndicate routing graphs with the native nexus_topology tool for zero-day reachability triage, surgical context slicing, and blast-radius prediction.
skills.capability_note: Guidance only; combines with native nexus_topology tool for deterministic supply-chain and surface graph queries.

skills.name: whitehat-repro-patch
skills.description: Verify and remediate vulnerabilities using deterministic Fail-Before-Fix reproduction harnesses, parser/auth/setpoint boundary tests, and 5-Gate completion receipts.
skills.capability_note: Guidance only; requires executable Fail-Before-Fix and Pass-After-Fix test evidence.
